acceptance_criteria.name: explicit_one_shot_authorization
acceptance_criteria.requirement: G1 execution may start only after explicit approval of this packet or equivalent bounds.

acceptance_criteria.name: bounded_runtime_and_concurrency
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Exactly one run, timeout <=1800s, abort-on-lock concurrency guard, and documented kill switch.

acceptance_criteria.name: side_effect_zero_by_default
acceptance_criteria.requirement: No cron, optimizer, production loop, network/API calls, runtime mutation, external PR update, auto-merge, or deploy.

acceptance_criteria.name: reviewable_evidence_packet
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Run emits parseable JSON/Markdown summary, side-effect ledger, command ledger, and reviewer handoff.

acceptance_criteria.name: fail_closed_status_contract
acceptance_criteria.requirement: Any unexpected side effect, parse failure, lock conflict, budget breach, or unsafe data finding yields blocked/review-required status, not PASS.

acceptance_criteria.name: next_stage_blocked_without_review
acceptance_criteria.requirement: G2 bounded supervised runs remain blocked until G1 evidence is reviewed and explicitly approved.

kill_switch_contract.before_start: print process/session id, timeout, lock path, and run root
kill_switch_contract.during_run: terminate tracked process/session on user stop, timeout, or unsafe output
kill_switch_contract.after_stop: verify process stopped, write abort summary, then remove lock only if owned by this run

post_run_review_requirements: side-effect ledger all false for blocked flags
high-risk secret/private-data scan has no findings
scheduler dry-run created no cron and took no action
human decision recorded before any cron or optimizer activation
recommended_next_action: If this packet is accepted, either path-limit commit/push it into PR #108 as evidence or give a separate explicit G1 execution approval. Do not execute G1, cron, optimizer, or production loop from this packet alone.
